instruction: A candid cinematic still, medium full shot at eye-level, capturing an elderly couple walking on an outdoor historic cobblestone street during the day. On the left, the elderly man in the beige coat (R1) walks forward with a warm smile, looking ahead. On the right, the elderly woman in the beige coat (R2) walks beside him, looking at him with a joyful smile while gesturing with her left hand. The woman (R2) has her right arm linked through the man's (R1) left arm. The background features blurred historic buildings under soft, natural daylight, creating a warm, neutral-toned atmosphere.
